items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: So they say Doc played a little different stuff with stuff I was composing, didn't know it.

ctx.x: I can bum a ride with you.

Yes, that's right, yes, we have, right on the corner, that particular, right across from McDonough 6 school, and the Bowmans always had pews way up in front of the church, but when Papa, Mama married Papa, he was dark, brown skinned, and the ushers would, came up to Papa, and asked him to please be seated in the rear of the church, because that they had reservations for colored people to sit in the back of the church, that time they had a little sign for colored only, back there, see, for colored patrons only.…
How much did you get a week ordinarily?
